about: The revenue anomaly explainer's thresholds. scripts/decompose_change.py reads this file, and so do apps that compute the same numbers, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.top: Rows in each table's rising and falling lists (the --top default).
notes.outlier_spread_multiple: A day is a one-off when its gap is more than this many typical deviations (median absolute deviation) from the median daily gap.
notes.concentrated_share: The change is concentrated when the fewest days that make up this share of the total gap are few enough (see concentrated_max_days_divisor).
notes.concentrated_max_days_divisor: Those days may be at most one in this many days of the period (at least one day).
notes.step_min_days: A step change is only looked for in a trend with at least this many days.
notes.step_min_side_days: A step needs at least this many days before it and after it.
notes.step_shift_sd_multiple: A step counts when the shift in the mean daily gap is at least this many times the scatter of days around it.
notes.noise_min_days: Days with data needed in the previous period to measure day-to-day noise; with fewer the verdict is unknown.
notes.noise_normal_ratio: A total change smaller than this many noise bands (daily standard deviation x square root of days) is within normal variation.
notes.noise_borderline_ratio: Below this many noise bands (and at least noise_normal_ratio) the change is borderline; at or above it, larger than normal variation.
